summary: The public curated build7 incident records an objcopy invocation that omitted a distinct output operand and rewrote the retained dedicated binaries. Immediate SHA checks detected contamination; those binaries became inadmissible and historical manifests were retained. A separate correction also rejected the claim that build7 dedicated reproduced build6 and distinguished dedicated/headless/plugin identities. Treat inspection tools with write capability as effects: preserve immutable originals, use a separate output when needed and revalidate candidate bytes before repinning. This is the specific historical custom-lineage incident, not evidence that current stock inputs are contaminated or that their loaded identity is known.
title: Read-intended artifact tooling can rewrite the candidate in place
